integrationReview.summary: The adapter introduces a non-standard CATui environment command (0x20000u | 0x100u) to fetch a game/mod directory and includes several language option mappings that may not match upstream settings. These, plus the large unverified libretro_core.cpp excerpt, require review against the approved upstream ABI/options before integration can continue.
risks: Uses a custom non-libretro environment command (0x20000u | 0x100u) whose semantics are not part of the standard retro_environment ABI; integration compatibility with the host cannot be confirmed.

Legacy variable list for eden_language uses 'portuguese_br' which does not match any defined option value ('brazilian_portuguese'), while v2 definitions include additional languages; option/ABI mismatch across versions.
libretro_core.cpp excerpt is truncated, so host callback, controller/rumble, audio, graphics, reset/shutdown and embedded-resource handling cannot be verified from this review.
